claude_proposed_widenings.name: recover_spell_slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Pearl of Power's sole mechanic is recovering an expended spell slot up to a given level. No existing EffectAtom models the recovery/restoration of an expended spell slot. This is distinct from grant_spell_access (which grants access to cast a spell), grant_temp_hp, heal_hp, and all other existing atoms. The concept of a character's spell slot economy being restored mid-encounter or mid-day has no current surface representation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower
